perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.description: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.description: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.description: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Genesis
perks.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.description: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Firmly Planted
perks.description: Increased accuracy, stability, and handling when firing while crouched.

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.description: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.description: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Clown Cartridge
perks.description: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Full Court
perks.description: Increases detonation damage as the projectile travels further before exploding.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: One for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Danger Zone
perks.description: The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.
